stories.headline: Pakistani becomes first foreigner aboard China's space station
stories.hook: Pakistan's Zeeshan Ali becomes first foreigner aboard China's Tiangong station
points: Shenzhou-24 crew entered Tiangong at 14:35, about six hours after launch from Jiuquan.
Ali, 40, is a payload specialist staying five to ten days; he trained seven months in Beijing.
He will help test self-healing carbon fibre composites that repair cracks in spacecraft.
stories.summary: Shenzhou-24: 08:18 Beijing launch, 11:56 docking. Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, 40, a former Pakistan Air Force pilot, joins Tang Hongbo and Wu Yi; stays 5 to 10 days.

stories.headline: AI doubts return: Kospi plunges 6.2%
stories.hook: Kospi falls 6.16% to 4,697.51 as doubts over AI investment return
points: Samsung fell 9.87% and SK Hynix 11.05%; foreign investors sold nearly 1.9 trillion won.
Taiex closed down 4.8% after falling more than 8%; Nikkei 225 dropped 2.8%.
Samsung's market capitalization fell to 998 trillion won, below the 1,000 trillion won mark.
stories.summary: Kospi -6.16% to 4,697.51, under 5,000. SK hynix -11.05%, Samsung -9.87% as banks cut targets. Taiex -4.8% after falling 8%; Nikkei -2.8%.

stories.headline: US proposes new tariffs on 14 economies
stories.hook: US proposes tariffs on 14 economies, citing excess manufacturing capacity
points: Proposed headline rates range from 20% to 40%, capped lower under existing or pending trade deals.
China faces 20% on top of roughly 25% first-term tariffs, about 45% overall.
Duties would not take effect until after public hearings that begin on January 25, 2027.
stories.summary: USTR cites 'excess capacity': up to 20% on China, 15% EU, 25% India, 35% Vietnam. China, the EU, Japan, India and 10 others named. Hearings January 2027; not in force yet.

stories.headline: Saudi-led coalition strikes Hodeidah port
stories.hook: Saudi-led coalition struck Hodeidah port and said it hit Houthi operational capabilities.
points: Coalition issued an evacuation warning for the port.

stories.headline: Iran says two tankers hit mines, caught fire
stories.hook: Iran said two oil tankers hit naval mines and caught fire near the Strait of Hormuz.
points: Iran said the tankers had deactivated identification and navigation systems.
Iran warned the strait would stay closed until its demands were met.
An army commander cited seven conditions for reopening the waterway.

stories.headline: Ukrainian drones set two refineries ablaze
stories.hook: Ukrainian drones hit two Rosneft refineries in Samara Region and set both on fire.
points: The targets were the Syzran and Kuibyshev refineries, both Rosneft-owned.
A regional governor said 145 drones were shot down and one person was killed.
Ukraine's forces have struck 16 Russian refineries since the beginning of November.

stories.headline: Solomon Islands signs security treaty
stories.hook: Solomon Islands signed a security treaty with Australia that bans foreign military bases
points: Names Australia its primary security partner; bars foreign military bases on its territory
Solomon Islands will not renew its security pact with China when its five-year term ends next April
Wale cited a confidentiality clause in the China pact and said he cannot speak about that matter
stories.summary: Australia: primary partner; no foreign bases.

stories.headline: UK energy cap to jump 26% in January
stories.hook: Ofgem lifted the UK energy price cap 26% from January 1, taking a typical bill to £2,166
points: Cap rises £443 a year, or £36.91 a month, for a typical household in England, Scotland and Wales
Regulator says the Middle East war keeps wholesale gas prices high; highest cap since 2023
About 20 million households get a £100 payment from January; 10 million on fixed tariffs unaffected

stories.headline: Flood traps miners in illegal gold pits
stories.hook: Flood in an unauthorized gold mine in West Java killed 9; rescuers search for 17 more
points: Heavy rain made the Ciseureuh River overflow into a shaft about 330 feet deep late Monday
Police got reports about 16 hours later; the mine was illegal so nobody reported it
325 rescuers used submersible pumps; water in the shaft has not yet receded

stories.headline: Garment minimum wage rises 36%
stories.hook: Bangladesh wage board backs a 36% rise in the garment minimum wage after protests
points: The board's chairman said a majority supported a minimum of 17,000 taka a month.
Workers had demanded 30,000 taka; it is unclear whether they will accept the rise.
Wages will be revised every three years instead of five; the BGMEA put unrest losses at $428m.

stories.headline: Israeli strike kills Hamas security chief
stories.hook: Israeli air strike killed Hamas internal security chief Naeem Abu Nahel in Gaza City
points: Gaza's interior ministry said he was targeted by an aircraft in western Gaza City; he was 50.
He had held the post since September, when his predecessor was captured in an Israeli raid.
Six others were killed in two strikes elsewhere in Gaza on Tuesday, responders and officials said.
stories.summary: Abu al-Auf, wife, two daughters killed.

stories.headline: Court throws out Phala Phala report
stories.hook: Court set aside the Phala Phala panel report and Parliament's steps based on it
points: Judges declared the Section 89 panel report unlawful and reviewed and set it aside in its entirety.
Each party must pay its own costs, and an appeal is expected.
The 2022 panel found preliminary evidence Ramaphosa may have violated the Constitution and the law.
stories.summary: Ramaphosa: report, parliament steps set aside.

stories.headline: Russian strikes cut power in five regions
stories.summary: Five killed; nuclear plant on diesel.

stories.headline: RSF drones kill at least 19 in Blue Nile
stories.hook: RSF drone attacks killed at least 19 civilians in Sudan's Blue Nile, a rights group said
points: Most casualties were in al-Damazin, where the RSF launched more than 30 explosive drones
Drone attacks also hit electricity facilities in Damazin and a big dam in Roseires
No immediate comment from Sudanese authorities or the RSF on the reported casualties

stories.headline: Tokyo: second extra budget, quake aid.
stories.hook: Takaichi ordered a second fiscal 2026 extra budget, mainly for disaster response.
points: It is expected to be relatively modest, unlike recent budgets aimed at energy costs.
Japan was hit by a major earthquake in Kumamoto in July and torrential rains in Chiba in August.
A draft budget plan calls for reviewing funds, subsidies and tax breaks to curb wasteful spending.

stories.headline: Regulator sues Google for RM60m.
stories.hook: Malaysia's regulator sued Google for 600 million ringgit over harmful YouTube content.
points: Two suits seek 300 million ringgit each, over gambling, scams and fraud content and other breaches.
It sent 74,703 reports from Jan. 1 to Oct. 28; 4,950 drew no response.
The second suit cites republished content by blogger Papagomo despite a court injunction.

stories.headline: Building collapses: 3 dead, 14 hurt.
stories.hook: Several people were trapped when a building collapsed in Baloch Colony, Karachi.
points: The front page lists 3 dead and 14 hurt.
A headline on the collapse lists 1 dead and 8 hurt.

stories.headline: Court voids RBI edict on 'bank' assets.
Saudi: 4 Houthi drones downed; no casualties.
stories.hook: Saudi air defences destroyed four Houthi drones over Ras Tanura, coalition says.
points: Coalition spokesman Turki Al-Maliki said fragments fell and an initial assessment found no injuries.
The interceptions followed a Saudi-led coalition strike on Yemen's Hodeidah port.
A day earlier, a Houthi drone hit a Riyadh tower, injuring at least 11 people.

stories.headline: Houthis threaten Jeddah, Saudi Red Sea ports.
stories.hook: Houthis threaten Jeddah and other Saudi Red Sea ports over Hodeidah strikes.
points: Saree urged port workers and residents to leave the sites and shipping firms to withdraw vessels.
A drone hit Riyadh's tallest tower on Tuesday and injured at least 11 people.
Hodeidah handles food, fuel and humanitarian supplies for northern Yemen.

stories.headline: Judges urge dropping case 4000 bribery charge.
Review: Met racist and misogynist.
stories.hook: Review says Met police remain institutionally racist, misogynistic and homophobic.
points: Review found no good progress on any of Casey's 14 recommendations.
Nine recommendations showed some progress and five limited progress.
Commissioner Sir Mark Rowley accepted the review's 10 recommendations.

stories.headline: EU-Western Balkans summit: Serbia absent.
stories.hook: EU and Western Balkan leaders meet in Brussels; Serbia is absent.
points: Antonio Costa and Ursula von der Leyen chair the summit.
The EU has earmarked up to 6 billion euros in support for the Western Balkans Growth Plan.
Serbia's Aleksandar Čupić will not travel; the European Commission confirmed his absence.

stories.headline: 24-hour strike halts ferries, regional flights.
stories.hook: A 24-hour strike in Greece halts ferries and disrupts metro and regional flights.
points: Unions seek wage increases, restored annual bonuses and more health and education spending.
Athens metro and trams run only from 09:00 to 18:00; buses run to schedule.
ADEDY called the public sector strike; rallies are planned in more than 60 cities.

stories.headline: Eurostar staff strike cancels London trains.
Nollywood legend Pete Edochie dies at 79
Army detains 5 tons of lead azide.
Carney: Trump hasn't raised defence criticism.
Sheinbaum seeks Inés Gómez Mont's extradition.
Lula signs public accounts control law.
47,000 women killed by partners or relatives in 2025; five an hour.
Violence against women: 16 days of activism.
